description: Election Commission - Declare that S. Adamwawa and A. A. Wahidu as members of the Ninthavur P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the resignation of members, nomination of replacements by a recognized political party, and the formal declaration of newly elected members by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely within the Elections category as it concerns electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
